notes.title: Brand new UI and weekly challenge!
notes.content:
A lot of work has been done to change the UI, making it easier to use, more intuitive, and preparing next developments! 

A new global score system for "Total" leaderboards has been set up: every game counts. That will now be all the money earned by playing, to reward people who play regularly. 
Levels leaderboards stay the same, only the best score on each level.

And last but not least, a new level: [u][b]weekly challenge[/b][/u]! Each week, compete against other players by playing a completely unique level, including exclusive recipes! Play as much as you want before the end of the week, to beat the highest score and win the grand prize!

notes.title: Good bye, Christmas skin!
notes.content: Time to go for the Christmas skin... Back to normal!

notes.title: Christmas update!
notes.content:
It's Christmas season, let's celebrate by enjoying a new Christmas skin in Sep's Diner restaurants! 

Sep's Diner, Sep's Donut and even the pumpkins and bats of the Halloween foodtruck have put on their Christmas outfits!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed startup issue and total score display bug in leaderboard

notes.title: Halloween update! New restaurant!
notes.content:
[b]The spookiest of days is upon us! [/b]

This year, Halloween brings a new restaurant to Sep's Diner! And quite a few bats as well!

Enjoy the brand new food truck and cook some delicious kebabs for your hungry customers!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed bug where objects would stop spawning during very long infinite-mode plays

notes.title: Infinite Modes !
notes.content: Sep's Diner gets two new infinite game modes! Fight against the clock and try to stay opened for as long as possible! Be ready for never-ending rush hours!

notes.title: Unicorn avatar and small bug fixes
notes.content: Added a unicorn avatar and corrected small bug fixes.

notes.title: New dessert restaurant + Leaderboards!
notes.content:
Sep's Diner new Dessert restaurant is HERE! 
Including 27 new levels: 12 on Timed, 12 on Relaxed and 3 on Multiplayer mode! 

But that's not all: leaderboards are now included! You can try to beat the best scores to be the best chef in town, on each restaurant.

notes.title: Multiplayer is OUT!
notes.content:
You have been so many wanting, asking and waiting for the multiplayer version...

It was our plan from the beginning, and here it is: the co-op multiplayer mode is OUT! It's a beta version so it will improve with time (we will add leaderboards and more) but it is already completely playable and above all, it's very, very fun! You can decide to be the host server, set a name for it and a password if you like, or join a existing server, it's up to you :)

If you want, you'll find others players in our [url=https://discord.gg/B7w33ZnYY3]Discord[/url] and our community to have some great multiplayer cooking sessions!

notes.title: Multiplayer is out!
notes.content: It was our plan from the beginning, and here it is: the 4 players co-op multiplayer mode is OUT! It's a beta version so it will improve with time (we will add leaderboards and more) but it is already completely playable and above all, it's very, very fun! You can decide to be the host server, set a name for it and a password if you like, or join a existing server, it's up to you!

notes.title: Sep's Diner - Lunar New Year Sale
notes.content:
To celebrate the Year of the Ox, Sep's Diner is 40% off!

Enjoy it before February 15th!

notes.title: Big updates are coming soon!
notes.content:
It's been a while since the last update, but we can promise you: we haven't been idle!

We are currently working on BIG updates that will come very soon: the co-op multiplayer mode and a brand new dessert restaurant! There's still some work to do, but it's already super fun. We can't wait for you to play it!

We plan to release the multiplayer mode in 3 weeks, on February 22nd. Be ready and call your friends, it's gonna get messy!

Stay put for the next news, we are doing our best to make it happen real soon!

notes.title: NEW MODES UPDATE
notes.content:
Christmas is coming, but it seems like Santa has already come... Enjoy 2 [b]new game-modes and a navigation update[/b]!

[list]
[*]Enjoy Sep's Diner in its "Relaxed" mode, without any timer. You can take as much time as you need to satisfy your customers!
[*]Let your imagination and creativity run free in the "Studio" mode. You can cook the meal you want, the craziest or the highest burger... Take a screenshot and share your creation on your favorite social media!
[*]New joystick navigation, as many asked for: left for 6-axis translation, right for rotation.
[/list]

Happy Holidays!
